dacnay816y62-hub-regional-culture-poster.description: Convert Chinese provinces, municipalities, autonomous regions, cities, counties, ancient cities, and cultural regions into restrained contemporary posters led by one culturally transformed Chinese character. Supports direct one-shot final image generation and layered production. Use when the user asks for a 中国省域文化海报、城市文化海报、地域文化视觉、极简大字海报、地区系列海报、展览主视觉、出版或社交封面，requests 直接生成、一次成图、不合成、不要后期、direct generation, or wants cultural analysis, art direction, image prompts, rendered poster images, or a coherent batch series for places such as 北京、广东、福建、江南、岭南、巴蜀 or 关中.
